app.name: OmniCore
error.backend_restarted: The backend restarted before the job completed.
error.confirmation_required: Explicit confirmation with matching name or size is required.
error.context_limit_exceeded: The prompt exceeds the model context. Shorten the conversation or explicitly choose a context supported by the model and available memory.
error.conversation_busy: A generation is active. Cancel it before changing this resource.
error.cuda_runtime_unavailable: The CUDA engine cannot load its runtime libraries or driver. Check diagnostics or use Auto/CPU.
error.download_integrity_error: The downloaded model failed size, checksum or format validation.
error.download_network_error: The model download service is unavailable or returned a network error.
error.download_redirect_denied: The download redirect is not permitted.
error.empty_response: The engine returned no final answer. Check the chat template and finish reason; the context was not increased automatically.
error.engine_invalid_response: The inference engine returned an invalid response.
error.engine_rejected_request: The engine rejected this model or request.
error.forbidden_network: This server accepts private LAN connections only.
error.generation_failed: Generation failed. Check the selected model and engine.
error.generation_limit_exceeded: The generated response exceeds the configured safety limit.
error.gpu_layers_required: Select at least one GPU layer to require CUDA.
error.gpu_offload_unverified: The engine did not confirm moving any layers to GPU. Auto can use CPU; check GPU settings and engine compatibility.
error.gpu_unavailable: No working GPU engine/device was found. Use Auto for CPU fallback or check engine diagnostics.
error.history_changed: History changed on another device. Refresh and confirm deletion again.
error.idempotency_conflict: This request key has already been used with different input.
error.invalid_gguf: The file is not a valid supported GGUF structure.
error.invalid_model_source: The model repository or filename is invalid.
error.invalid_path: The path is not an allowed regular file, or contains a symlink.
error.invalid_task_state: This operation is not allowed in the current job state.
error.lan_restart_required: The network address changed after server startup. Restart your server before generating a new QR.
error.model_file_changed: The registered model file has changed. Import it again.
error.model_load_failed: The model could not be loaded. Check engine version and model compatibility.
error.model_required: Select a registered model for this conversation.
error.not_found: The requested resource was not found.
error.out_of_memory: The engine ran out of memory.
error.pairing_admin_required: Manage pairing from the computer that owns the server.
error.pairing_expired: Pairing code expired. Generate a new QR on the computer and scan it.
error.pairing_invalid: The pairing code is invalid, expired, cancelled or already used. Create a new code.
error.pairing_lan_required: Enable the private LAN server before pairing.
error.pairing_rate_limited: Too many pairing attempts. Wait one minute.
error.pairing_used: This code is already bound to another pairing attempt. Use Retry on the original phone or generate a new QR.
error.provider_auth_failed: The provider rejected this key or its permissions. Check the saved key on the backend.
error.provider_confirmation_required: Explicitly confirm adding an external model before using it.
error.provider_connection_failed: Cannot connect to the provider. Check network access and TLS.
error.provider_content_blocked: The provider stopped this request or requested an unsupported tool.
error.provider_cost_confirm: Add this external model to the chat selector? Selecting it sends conversation history to the provider and may incur charges on your key. Automatic titles make a small additional request to the same provider.
error.provider_delete_confirm: Remove this provider, its stored key and catalog entries? Conversation history is preserved.
error.provider_endpoint_invalid: Use the official endpoint, or a public HTTPS custom endpoint without credentials or query parameters.
error.provider_key_invalid: Enter a valid printable API key without whitespace.
error.provider_key_missing: No provider key is stored. Configure it on the backend computer.
error.provider_key_reentry_required: Changing the destination requires a new key. An existing key is never forwarded to a changed endpoint.
error.provider_key_requires_https: Configure the key on the Linux computer, or use HTTPS to transfer it. Provider keys cannot be sent over LAN HTTP.
error.provider_key_saved: Key stored on the backend; its value is not displayed.
error.provider_model_not_found: The provider does not expose this model or endpoint to your account.
error.provider_not_found: Provider configuration no longer exists. Refresh the list.
error.provider_parameter_unsupported: The selected model/provider does not support these sampling parameters. Disable sampling or adjust its range.
error.provider_permission_required: This API token cannot manage providers. Ask the computer owner for a token with provider permission.
error.provider_rate_limited: The provider rate or quota limit was reached. Wait or check the account limits.
error.provider_request_rejected: The provider rejected the request. Check model capabilities and configured parameters.
error.provider_requires_server_auth: External providers require an authenticated backend. Start the backend from the desktop app or configure its API token.
error.provider_response_invalid: The provider returned an invalid or oversized response.
error.provider_sampling: Send sampling parameters supported by the selected model
error.provider_secret_store_unavailable: System Secret Service is unavailable or locked. Unlock the session keyring on the Linux backend. No plaintext fallback is used.
error.provider_test_ok: Authenticated model-list request succeeded. Generation was not invoked.
error.provider_unavailable: The provider is unavailable. Retry later; no fallback provider was called.
error.queue_full: The job queue is full. Try again later.
error.reasoning_limit_reached: The token limit was used for reasoning before a final answer. Disable thinking if the model supports it, or explicitly adjust the answer limit.
error.remote_metadata_too_large: Remote model metadata exceeds the size limit.
error.request_too_large: The request exceeds the size limit.
error.token_expiry_invalid: Choose an expiry within the next 366 days, or no expiry.
error.unsupported_backend: This operation is not supported by this backend.
error.unsupported_parameter: This engine does not support the selected parameter.
